creditBankEquityShareOfDeposits.citation: Median of cushion plus other assets less deposits, as a share of deposits, over the 3,194 FDIC-insured banks under $1 billion, June 30, 2026 call reports (data/tables/town-bank-shapes.json).

spread.citation: 10th and 90th percentiles of the same banks.

creditLineMonthsOfPayroll.citation: Small firms seek lines covering a few months of operating costs (Federal Reserve Small Business Credit Survey, 2023 Report on Employer Firms).

spread.citation: Small firms seek lines covering a few months of operating costs (Federal Reserve Small Business Credit Survey, 2023 Report on Employer Firms).

creditPrimeSpreadPct.citation: Small business lines price at prime plus one to three points (Federal Reserve Survey of Terms of Business Lending, 2010-2017; SBA 7(a) maximums).

spread.citation: Small business lines price at prime plus one to three points (Federal Reserve Survey of Terms of Business Lending, 2010-2017; SBA 7(a) maximums).

creditRiskSpreadPct.citation: A borrower whose sales barely cover its wages pays more (SBA 7(a) spread caps by loan size).

spread.unit: percentage points at the weakest record
spread.citation: A borrower whose sales barely cover its wages pays more (SBA 7(a) spread caps by loan size).

creditCapitalAppetiteSlope.citation: A bank lends less as its capital falls below where it opened, on a sliding scale (Federal Reserve Senior Loan Officer Survey: tightening with capital and risk).

spread.citation: A bank lends less as its capital falls below where it opened, on a sliding scale (Federal Reserve Senior Loan Officer Survey: tightening with capital and risk).

creditMaxLimitsPerEquity.citation: Small banks hold loans of about eight to twelve times their equity (FDIC Quarterly Banking Profile, community banks).

spread.unit: line limits per dollar of equity
spread.citation: Small banks hold loans of about eight to twelve times their equity (FDIC Quarterly Banking Profile, community banks).

creditDepositsInThousands.citation: FDIC Summary of Deposits reports deposits in thousands of dollars.

creditPersonalSpreadPct.citation: Commercial bank 24-month personal loan rates ran about 6 to 9 points over prime, 2015-2024 (Federal Reserve G.19, terms of credit).

spread.citation: Commercial bank 24-month personal loan rates ran about 6 to 9 points over prime, 2015-2024 (Federal Reserve G.19, terms of credit).

creditPersonalTermMonths.citation: Federal Reserve G.19 reports personal loans at a 24-month term.

creditDtiReferencePct.citation: 12 CFR 1026.43(e)(2)(vi) (2014-2021 general qualified mortgage): total debt payments at most 43 percent of monthly income.

creditDtiSlope.citation: A lender's yes falls smoothly as payments approach and pass the reference share of income.

spread.citation: A lender's yes falls smoothly as payments approach and pass the reference share of income.

creditChargeOffDays.citation: FFIEC Uniform Retail Credit Classification and Account Management Policy (65 FR 36903, 2000): closed-end retail loans are charged off at 120 days past due.

creditBorrowNeedWeight.citation: A household with few days of money left wants to borrow.

spread.citation: A household with few days of money left wants to borrow.

creditBorrowCostWeight.citation: The payment against income weighs against borrowing.

spread.unit: score per share of monthly income
spread.citation: The payment against income weighs against borrowing.

creditBorrowBaseline.citation: How far borrowing sits below doing without, before need; checked against G.19 consumer credit growth and SCF borrowing shares.

spread.citation: How far borrowing sits below doing without, before need; checked against G.19 consumer credit growth and SCF borrowing shares.

creditPersonalMonthsOfCosts.citation: Personal loans cover a few months of costs (SCF 2022 median unsecured installment balance about 2 to 3 months of median household spending).
